question: Who is the author of the English novel 'Voting at Fosterganj'?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ruskin Bond**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Ruskin Bond** is a celebrated **Indian author** of British descent known for his **contribution to English literature**.
 
• He has written numerous books, short stories, and essays, many of which focus on **childhood experiences**, **nature**, and life in the **hill stations of India**.
 
• The novel **'Voting at Fosterganj'** is one of his works that reflects his **characteristic storytelling style**, filled with humor, warmth, and an insightful look at life in a small town.
